summary.text: Mason Blankenship is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran who works as a risk manager, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is focused on accountability and representing working families.

paragraphs.text: Mason Blankenship served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2005 to 2010.
He earned a high school diploma from Gahanna Lincoln High School and a bachelor's degree from Franklin University in 2020.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as risk manager.
Blankenship said in a Ballotpedia survey that he decided to run because public office should be about service, and that his risk management work shapes a practical approach to policy.
His key messages included getting politics back to serving the people and restoring integrity and accountability.
He named affordability, healthcare, education, environmental protection and government accountability as the issues he is most passionate about.
